newsitem.title: USA: NYC comptroller taps Halverson for finance spot.
newsitem.headline: NYC comptroller taps Halverson for finance spot.

text.p: New York City Comptroller Alan Hevesi has selected Richard Halverson as the new deputy comptroller for finance, city sources said on Thursday.

Halverson now serves as deputy comptroller for the budget, and starting on January 29th, he will replace Patrice Mitchell, who left to join the Philadelphia-based financial advisory firm of P.G. Corbin & Co.
Halverson's role in the comptroller's office will be filled by Jacques Jiha, chief economist. No one has been selected for top economist slot, said the city sources, who declined to be named.
